Here's a simple bodyweight exercise routine:

**Warm-up:**

* March in place for 5 minutes
* Jumping jacks for 1 minute
* Stretch your major muscle groups (legs, arms, back, and chest)

**Monday ( Upper Body):**

* Push-ups (3 sets of 10 reps)
* Tricep dips (using a chair or bench) (3 sets of 10 reps)
* Arm circles (hold arms straight out to the sides and make small circles) (3 sets of 10 reps)

**Wednesday (Lower Body):**

* Squats (3 sets of 10 reps)
* Calf raises (stand on the edge of a step or curb with heels hanging off) (3 sets of 15 reps)
* Glute bridges (lie on your back with knees bent and lift hips up towards ceiling) (3 sets of 10 reps)

**Friday (Core):**

* Plank (hold for 30-60 seconds)
* Russian twists (sit on floor with knees bent and feet flat, twist torso to left and right) (3 sets of 10 reps)
* Leg raises (lie on your back with arms extended overhead and lift legs up towards ceiling) (3 sets of 10 reps)

**Remember:** Start slow, rest when needed, and listen to your body. If you experience any discomfort or pain, stop immediately and consult a professional.
